description: Build and edit tile-based 2D levels in Godot 4.7 with TileMapLayer and TileSet: paint layers, set up collision/navigation/custom-data on tiles, autotile with terrain sets, and read/write cells from code (set_cell, get_cell_tile_data, local_to_map).
